findings: The before-fix mobile light capture exposed a dark transcript slab inside otherwise light controls, materially weakening empty-state readability and theme coherence.
After repair, desktop and mobile Chat surfaces use the active semantic palette in both themes with no horizontal overflow or clipped consent copy.
All four after captures visibly expose the optional bankroll/active-books disclosure and the personalization checkbox remains unchecked by default.
The input, send action, close action, usage state, and privacy disclosure remain reachable at 1440×1000 and 390×844.
fixesApplied: Replaced PromoChat's hard-coded dark panel and border colors with render-time semantic theme tokens.
Added explicit accessible names to the floating Chat trigger, close control, and message input.
Added client/server redaction, versioned consent enforcement, bounded history/profile egress, and an inspectable privacy receipt.
Added a dependency-free isolated Chromium capture harness that asserts visible disclosure, unchecked consent, and viewport overflow before saving evidence.
